concept: Taking ownership of a setback instead of blaming outside factors
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Stoic ownership-of-response tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student experiences a realistic setback (a failed test, a lost opportunity) with a genuine external factor and a genuine personal factor both in play
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to frame the setback to themselves and others
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up distinguishing what was actually within their control from what wasn't

assessment.success_marker: student identifies both a real external factor and a real personal factor, without collapsing into pure blame or pure self-blame
